name: 李宗益
objective:
本課程旨在為學生提供永續能源與淨零碳規劃管理的實務知識基礎，包括認識全球能源與環境的現況、掌握再生能源技術和能源效率提升的策略，並深入分析臺灣在永續能源發展上的政策、市場以及實際案例，並包含淨零碳規劃管理基礎概論與淨零碳盤查規範與程序概要，讓學生對於永續能源與淨零碳規劃管理策略有更詳盡的認知。本課程也將淨零碳規劃管理師考試流程和考試重點彙整至學習中，目標是協助學生通過淨零碳規劃管理師能力鑑定，使其能與產業接軌。
This course aims to provide students with a practical knowledge base in sustainable energy and net-zero carbon planning and management. It includes understanding the current global energy and environmental landscape, mastering renewable energy technologies, and strategies for enhancing energy efficiency. The course offers an in-depth analysis of Taiwan's policies, market, and practical cases in sustainable energy development. It also covers the fundamentals of net-zero carbon planning and management, along with an overview of the standards and procedures for net-zero carbon auditing. The course integrates the examination process and key points of the Net-Zero Carbon Planning and Management Certification, aiming to help students pass the certification and connect with the industry.
